import heapq


def pass_route(n: int, edges: list[list[int]], stations: list[list[int]], prices: list[int]) -> int:
    zones = len(prices)
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v, cost, zone in edges:
        adj[u].append((v, cost, zone))
        adj[v].append((u, cost, zone))

    sell = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for stop, zone in stations:
        sell[stop].append(zone)

    masks = 1 << zones
    inf = 10**18
    dist = [[inf] * masks for _ in range(n)]
    dist[0][0] = 0
    heap = [(0, 0, 0)]

    while heap:
        spent, node, owned = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if spent != dist[node][owned]:
            continue
        if node == n - 1:
            return spent
        for zone in sell[node]:
            bit = 1 << zone
            if owned & bit:
                continue
            nxt = owned | bit
            nxt_spent = spent + prices[zone]
            if nxt_spent < dist[node][nxt]:
                dist[node][nxt] = nxt_spent
                heapq.heappush(heap, (nxt_spent, node, nxt))
        for nxt_node, cost, zone in adj[node]:
            pay = cost
            if zone != -1 and (owned & (1 << zone)):
                pay = 0
            nxt_spent = spent + pay
            if nxt_spent < dist[nxt_node][owned]:
                dist[nxt_node][owned] = nxt_spent
                heapq.heappush(heap, (nxt_spent, nxt_node, owned))

    best = min(dist[n - 1])
    return best if best < inf else -1
